items.title: OpenSpug Spug文件传输命令注入
items.title_zh: OpenSpug Spug文件传输命令注入
items.summary_zh: 可访问文件传输功能的远程攻击者可通过 /exec/transfer 注入系统命令，完全控制服务器。
items.action_zh: 厂商未回应，暂无官方修复；限制 /exec/transfer 访问并加强鉴权
items.repro_note: 入口 /exec/transfer；需能调用文件传输功能，构造恶意参数触发命令拼接
items.impact_scope: 内网运维管理平台，横向移动跳板
items.description: A flaw has been found in OpenSpug Spug up to 3.4.0/4.0.1. This impacts an unknown function of the file /exec/transfer of the component File Transfer. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
